character.name: Deniz
character.current_goal: Understand why a bell-like sound is heard near the Commons path without crossing into unknown areas.
established_knowledge: OLD_PUMP_PATH is only rumored; Deniz has not visited it.
The public notice board is beside the Commons shelter.
The maintenance shed may be approached only from the marked public path.
prohibited_knowledge: Deniz does not know what is inside the old pump house.
Deniz does not know whether the old pump house still contains machinery.
Deniz has never seen the source of the bell-like sound.

local_areas.summary: Family apartment above the public garden edge.
Public garden commons with shelter, notice board, rain barrel and marked paths.
Fenced maintenance edge visible from the marked public path.
A rumored path beyond the current knowledge boundary. It must not become explored in this story.

current_facts: A soft metallic bell-like tone has been reported near the Commons on windy afternoons.
A maintenance notice says workers recently replaced a loose sign bracket near MAINTENANCE_EDGE.
Visitors must stay on marked public paths.
No dangerous incident has been reported.
hidden_facts_not_available_to_story: The old pump house interior state is intentionally unknown.
No canonical source has established a connection between the old pump house and the sound.

opportunity.title: Trace the Commons bell-like sound from known ground
opportunity.premise: Deniz can investigate the recurring sound using observations available from explored/discovered public areas without entering OLD_PUMP_PATH.
opportunity.success_condition: Reach a bounded, evidence-supported explanation or explicitly preserve uncertainty if the evidence is insufficient.
constraints: Do not reveal hidden world facts.
Do not make an adult solve the investigation.
Do not create danger to raise stakes.

hard_rules: No supernatural explanation unless canon explicitly establishes it.
Character knowledge cannot exceed experienced or explicitly communicated facts.
Story consequences must be supportable by accepted prose evidence.

eligible_context: Deniz is gradually learning to separate observations, hypotheses and conclusions.
A recurring theme is that uncertainty can remain honest rather than being forced into a dramatic answer.
forbidden_reveal: Do not reveal the future reason OLD_PUMP_PATH matters.
Do not introduce a secret organization, hidden villain, or preplanned destiny.

relevant_memories.summary: In an earlier garden problem, Deniz changed a first guess after checking physical evidence.
relevant_memories.relevance: Supports a habit of revising hypotheses; must not be retold as a duplicate plot.
